churches.name: First Baptist Church Chattanooga

score_notes.gender: Male pastor. CBF allows women ordination.
score_notes.leadership: Quisenberry served as Moderator of TN CBF.
score_notes.cultural: CBF -- 'everyone has a place at the table' language. Watch for progressive drift.
score_notes.denominational: CBF since its founding (1992). Quisenberry is TN CBF Moderator.

churches.assessment: First Baptist Chattanooga is a CBF church since 1992 with Thomas Quisenberry as pastor since 2010. Quisenberry served as Moderator of the Tennessee CBF. The church describes itself as 'a community where everyone has a place at the table' -- inclusive language that may or may not extend to LGBTQ affirmation. CBF affiliation means moderate-to-progressive theology. Not SBC. Exercise caution.
churches.gender_detail: Male pastor. CBF allows women ordination.
